summary: Cramer's rule: the e_a-coordinate of uγf·(det Y·Y⁻¹_{·,b}) is the determinant of a block matrix built from the frame data of the boxed points y, γ⁻¹y (bounded by b^{5n²} entrywise) and the rows of Y; Hadamard's bound and q₀ ≥ b¹⁰ give the estimate.

steps.claim: The shared vector: f·w = γf·(column b of Y⁻¹) (exists_shared_frame_vector, j ≤ b); 2 ≤ b; γ near: y and γ_∞⁻¹y are boxed (p, q).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨w, e⟩, t : 2 ≤ S.b, y, p, q⟩ :=
    H ▸ h.2.exists_shared_frame_vector hb, by grind [thousand_le_b], h.1

steps.claim: Since besselSize(y_v) ≤ b^{6n+2}, write the element of 𝖴 with small norm on y_v as A·y_v⁻¹: ‖A‖ ≤ b^{6n+2} (r).
For a boxed z, g(z) is the (ϱ+1)×(ϱ+1) matrix with entries (s_v(f_k)/s_v(f_c))·⟨A_{f_k}, frameVector(z_v, c)⟩ (s_v the basis scales).
steps.lean:
let g {z} (_ : z ∈ S.boxedPoints) := of fun k c ↦ S.basisScale v (𝔰.besselFrame k) / S.basisScale
    v (𝔰.besselFrame c) * A.1.1 (𝔰.besselFrame k) ⬝ᵥ frameVector (z v) c

steps.claim: Every entry of g(z) has absolute value ≤ M.
steps.lean:
have G z h k c : ‖@g z h k c‖ ≤ M := by
    simp [g, M, basisScale_besselFrame, field] at *
    grw [show ‖_ ⬝ᵥ _‖ ≤ _ from (PiLp.norm_apply_le ..).trans (A.1.1.l2_opNorm_mulVec _),
      r, (h v).1 c, boxSize, ← one_le_abs_kappa, abs_kappa_le]; simp
    gcongr <;> nlinarith [S.ϱ_le, 𝔰.ϱ.sub_le k]

steps.claim: Unfold g, M and the basis scales.
|⟨A_{f_k}, x⟩| ≤ ‖A‖·‖x‖, with ‖A‖ ≤ b^{6n+2}, the boxed frame vectors ‖frameVector(z_v, c)‖ ≤ boxSize = b^{2n²}, and the scale ratios ≤ |κ_v|^{ϱ} ≤ b^{23ϱ}.
steps.lean:
show ‖_ ⬝ᵥ _‖ ≤ _ from (PiLp.norm_apply_le ..).trans (A.1.1.l2_opNorm_mulVec _),
      r, (h v).1 c, boxSize, ← one_le_abs_kappa, abs_kappa_le]; simp

steps.claim: The resulting power of b is at most b^{5n²} (ϱ ≥ 10⁵).

Cramer: the determinant of the block matrix (g(p), −g(q); 0, Φ_v(Y)) with the column a replaced by the combination is det(Φ_v(Y)) times the coordinate (the upper-left block is unitriangular because A comes from 𝖴, which is unitriangular on the frame).
steps.lean:
have k := by
    simpa [det_eq_one_of_unitriangular (Z :=
      g p) fun _ _ h ↦ congr(_ * $(frameMatrix_unitriangular hu _ _ h)).trans (by
      aesop)] using ((g p).fromBlocks (-g q) 0 (Y.map (Φ v))).det_updateCol_sum (.inl a.castSucc)

steps.claim: For each k: Σ_c Φ_v(w_c)·g(p)_{k,c} = Σ_c Φ_v(Y⁻¹_{c,b})·g(q)_{k,c} (apply A_{f_k}·(y_v)⁻¹ to the identity f w = γ f Y⁻¹_{·,b}).
steps.lean:
have E k : ∑ c, Φ v (w c) * g p k c = ∑ c, Φ v (Y⁻¹ c b) * g q k c := by
    convert congr(S.basisScale v (𝔰.besselFrame k) * A.1 (𝔰.besselFrame k) ⬝ᵥ (y v)⁻¹ *ᵥ (Φ v ∘ $e /
      S.basisScale v)) <;> simp [g, entrywise, Finset.sum_div, Subgroup.coe_mul, frameVector,
      ite_div, apply_ite, -sum_sum_type, @Finset.sum_comm (Fin _)] <;> grind [basisScale_ne_zero]
steps.typed_fact: ∑ c, Φ v (w c) * g p k c = ∑ c, Φ v (Y⁻¹ c b) * g q k c

steps.claim: Expand both sides through the frame vectors of y_v and of γ_∞⁻¹y_v.
steps.lean:
convert congr(S.basisScale v (𝔰.besselFrame k) * A.1 (𝔰.besselFrame k) ⬝ᵥ (y v)⁻¹ *ᵥ (Φ v ∘ $e /
      S.basisScale v)) <;> simp [g, entrywise, Finset.sum_div, Subgroup.coe_mul, frameVector,
